layer: one node's relay, sealed frames on air (protocol_spec.md 16.2)
rules: time advances event by event; at an instant: timers due before it, then the input, then timers due at it
every random draw: uniform(a, b) takes (a + b) / 2, random() takes 0.5
SNR = RSSI - noise_floor (-117 dBm); no channel activity detection; airtime SF7 / 125 kHz / CR 4/5
the relay's own frames and the layer above's share one FCNT counter from first_fcnt

expect lists every frame put on air ('tx', with 'preamble' when not 8 symbols), every frame handed up ('up'), every route failure reported ('route_failed') and radio setting change ('radio'), in order

cases.name: flood_relayed_once_after_rssi_backoff
cases.description: A REQUEST for someone else is relayed once, TX = this node, after a backoff that grows with RSSI; a later copy is a duplicate.

cases.name: outward_flood_suppressed_by_three_copies
cases.description: suppress_after (3) other copies of an outward flood heard during the backoff cancel this node's relay.

cases.name: reply_follows_the_backbone_and_is_confirmed
cases.description: A REPLY is relayed only by a node that relayed its request; a copy from the next relay confirms it.

cases.name: unconfirmed_reply_repeated_once
cases.description: confirm_replies: a relayed REPLY nobody passes on is repeated once, hop_timeout later.

cases.name: reply_off_the_backbone_dropped
cases.description: guided_replies: a REPLY to a request this node never relayed is not relayed.

cases.name: reply_cancels_the_waiting_request
cases.description: The REPLY heard while this node still waits to relay its request cancels that relay; never having relayed it, the node is not on the backbone and leaves the REPLY alone too.

cases.name: frame_for_this_node_goes_up_once
cases.description: A frame addressed to this node goes up (first copy only) and is not relayed.

cases.name: hello_is_one_hop
cases.description: A HELLO goes up (broadcast) and is never relayed.

cases.name: replays_forgeries_and_plain_frames_dropped
cases.description: Per origin a window of the highest FCNT and the 32 below it: an unseen FCNT inside it is fresh, one 32 or more behind is dropped, as are a bad MIC and an unsealed frame; nothing is recorded for them.

cases.name: own_frame_repeated_without_a_copy
cases.description: A frame this node originates is repeated (hop_retries 1) after hop_timeout unless a copy of it comes back.

cases.name: own_frame_acknowledged_by_a_relay_copy
cases.description: Any relay's copy of this node's own frame is its acknowledgement: no repeat.

cases.name: routed_forward_acknowledged_by_next_hop
cases.description: A listed relay forwards at once (jitter); the next hop's copy acknowledges it.

cases.name: routed_repeats_then_route_error
cases.description: No acknowledgement: route_retries (3) repeats, route_hop_timeout apart, then a ROUTE_ERROR (BROKEN = next hop) back along the route; the gateway's echo acknowledges it.

cases.name: routed_frame_not_on_route_ignored
cases.description: A routed frame that does not list this node is neither relayed nor handed up.

cases.name: routed_retry_answered_with_the_furthest_copy
cases.description: Acknowledged, then the previous hop sends again (it missed our copy): answered once with TX = the furthest node heard, which nobody further on takes for a retry.

cases.name: last_hop_into_gateway_acknowledged_by_echo
cases.description: The last relay before the gateway waits for the gateway's echo of the inbound frame (TX = gateway) like any other hop.

cases.name: skipped_hop_waits_a_slot
cases.description: Heard from before the previous hop (a skipped hop): wait one slot per relay in between; that relay's copy then acknowledges ours.

cases.name: routed_frame_for_this_node_goes_up
cases.description: A routed request to this node goes up; the answer the layer above hands down goes back on the reversed route and is acknowledged by the next hop's copy.

cases.name: target_answers_every_repeat_of_the_last_relay
cases.description: The target's answer goes again only when the last relay repeats the request; each repeat heard keeps it answerable for another full repeat cycle (linger_span).

cases.name: target_stops_answering_after_retry_cap
cases.description: The target sends the answer once and four repeats, five sends in all; a sixth request still reaches it after the fifth send, but it does not answer: route_retries+1 caps the repeats.

cases.name: probe_relayed_with_own_hop
cases.description: A PROBE is passed on once, re-sealed as this node's own frame (its FCNT) with its hop and the link appended, after a wait that is shorter the cheaper the path; no copy from further out: sent once more.

cases.name: probe_keeps_the_best_copy
cases.description: Copies heard while waiting: the cheapest path (ETX) is the one passed on.

cases.name: probe_passed_on_is_not_repeated
cases.description: A copy from further out that lists this node confirms its forward: no second copy.

cases.name: probe_target_answers_the_best_path
cases.description: The target collects copies for WINDOW after the first and answers the cheapest path with a routed PROBE_REPLY (back through INNER), which INNER's copy acknowledges.

cases.name: join_relayed_like_a_probe
cases.description: A JOIN floods towards the gateway like a probe: this node appends its hop and seals it as its own.

cases.name: keepalive_moves_after_the_answer_and_reverts
cases.description: A KEEPALIVE naming a radio setting: the path moves there once it has passed that keepalive's answer on (here: the gateway's echo), and back to the common setting after radio_timeout (6 s) of silence.

cases.name: wake_net_relayed_with_long_preamble
cases.description: WAKE_NET goes up (broadcast) and is relayed with the wake preamble.

cases.name: wake_net_repeated_for_a_silent_neighbour
cases.description: A neighbour known strong enough (wake_expect) and not heard since: this node sends the WAKE_NET again, wake_copies (3) in all.

cases.name: wake_net_not_repeated_once_the_neighbour_is_heard
cases.description: The known neighbour passes it on: no further copy.

cases.name: dormant_node_hears_only_wake_frames
cases.description: Dormant: a flooded REQUEST a CAD look caught is dropped unrecorded; a WAKE_NET is taken (the wake agent then wakes the node).

cases.name: trace_relayed_and_its_answer_carries_our_record
cases.description: A relay passes a routed request and its answer on (its route log notes both), then the TRACE asking about them; the target's TRACE_REPLY gets this relay's record appended and goes into the gateway twice, blind.

cases.name: trace_target_answers_with_its_record
cases.description: The TRACE's target answers along the route back with its own record; a copy from the next node, with its record added, acknowledges it.

cases.name: routed_probe_passed_on_by_the_next_listed_relay
cases.description: A probe along a route: only the next listed relay passes it on, with its own hop; the next relay's copy naming it confirms it.

cases.name: own_routed_probe_repeated_until_passed_on
cases.description: This node's own probe along a route: repeated (route_retries) while the first relay does not pass it on.
